scope.description: Actual installed InspectorChatPicker and five verbatim installed functions in a controlled DOM, navigated by file URL in a separate headless Chrome. This is not the original GUI or full original application.

protected.policy: Never signal, restart, navigate, read profile, or mutate. No operation in this runner targets these processes, port, or profiles.

scope.dependencies: Node >=24 built-ins, installed Chrome executable; no dependency install, builds, Go tests, model calls, application server, or external fetch.
scope.input: CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent and Input.dispatchKeyEvent only. No DOM dispatchEvent or direct picker event-handler calls.
scope.network: The runner connects only to the allocated 127.0.0.1 CDP endpoint. Fixture CSP denies network; page Network.setBlockedURLs blocks HTTP(S)/WS(S). Chrome background networking is disabled and DNS resolution is blocked.

extraction.method: Functions, POINTER_ACTIONS, and class sliced verbatim at exact original indentation boundaries. CSS decoded with JSON.parse from the installed generated literal; only the exact two installed picker rules are applied. The class and functions are not transformed, mocked, transpiled, or reimplemented.

harnessRevision.correction: First-run logger sampled defaultPrevented too early in a capture-listener microtask, missed Escape at document capture after window suppression, and required compatibility mouse events suppressed by cancelled pointerdown. Final logger observes at window capture before picker registration and reads retained native Event.defaultPrevented during the later snapshot. Assertions allow absent compatibility mouse events. Installed picker/functions/CSS were never changed.

limitations: Controlled main conversation DOM and fixture theme, not the full original application, current original GUI, live session data, React integration, or original Electron Chromium.
Only the extracted installed picker and its required functions/CSS are executed; unrelated installed module registration and app lifecycle are outside this acceptance scope.
Pixel-mode wheel forwarding is exercised. Line/page wheel delta modes, touch input, and platform-native menus are outside this run.

cleanup.target: Only the Chrome process spawned by this runner and its verified owned CDP browser
